title: Alpha and beta maps for computing resolutions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module with computing resolution $D$ [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data]. For any family $U_i$ of opens, use the existing double complex [def-sc-cech-cup-resolution-comparison-data], namely the first-quadrant double complex $B_D^{r,s}=\check C^s(U,D.K^r)$, with resolution degree first, using [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex, def-sp-double-complex-total]. Its total differential is $d_K+(-1)^r d_{\check C}$. Global sections $\Gamma(X,D.K)$ map to its total via restriction into the $(r,0)$ summand (alpha). The coefficient Cech complex maps to the $(0,s)$ summand through $D.augmentation$ (beta). The component formulas and their cochain identities define cupCechAlpha and cupCechBeta. These definitions require neither injectivity nor flasqueness nor a covering equation; they extend the injective-only construction [def-sc-module-cech-comparison].
